description: Utility class for XML processing in the OFBiz framework, including methods for parsing, transforming, and manipulating XML documents, as well as custom entity resolution and error handling.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalResolver
classes.description: Custom entity resolver for handling local DTDs and schemas to avoid external network calls during XML validation.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalErrorHandler
classes.description: Error handler that logs XML parsing errors, warnings, and fatal errors, especially when DTDs are involved.

methods.name: getDomLsImplementation
methods.description: Returns a DOMImplementationLS instance for DOM Level 3 Load and Save operations.

methods.name: createXStream
methods.description: Initializes and returns an XStream instance with default security settings.

methods.name: writeXmlDocument
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Node to an OutputStream or String with specified formatting options.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Parses XML content from String, URL, InputStream, or File into a Document object, with optional validation and position tracking.

methods.name: makeEmptyXmlDocument
methods.description: Creates a new empty XML Document, optionally with a specified root element.

methods.name: addChildElement
methods.description: Creates and appends a child element to a parent element.

methods.name: addChildElementValue
methods.description: Creates a child element with a text value and appends it to a parent element.

methods.name: addChildElementNSElement
methods.description: Creates and appends a namespace-aware child element.

methods.name: addChildElementNSValue
methods.description: Creates a namespace-aware child element with a text value.

methods.name: addChildElementCDATAValue
methods.description: Creates a child element with a CDATA section.

methods.name: childElementList
methods.description: Returns a list of child elements, optionally filtered by name or set of names.

methods.name: childNodeList
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes, including elements and comments.

methods.name: firstChildElement
methods.description: Returns the first child element matching optional name(s) or attribute criteria.

methods.name: elementValue
methods.description: Retrieves the concatenated text content of an element.

methods.name: nodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the concatenated text content of a node and its siblings.

methods.name: elementAttribute
methods.description: Gets the value of an attribute, with a default fallback.

methods.name: checkEmpty
methods.description: Returns the input string or empty string if null or empty, supports multiple overloads.

methods.name: checkBoolean
methods.description: Converts a string to boolean, with default value fallback.

methods.name: nodeNameToJavaName
methods.description: Converts an XML node name to a Java-style variable name, with optional capitalization.

methods.name: getNodeNameIgnorePrefix
methods.description: Returns node name without namespace prefix.

methods.name: getTagNameIgnorePrefix
methods.description: Returns element tag name without namespace prefix.

methods.name: getAttributeValueIgnorePrefix
methods.description: Retrieves attribute value ignoring prefix in attribute name.

methods.name: convertDocumentToXmlString
methods.description: Converts a Document object to a formatted XML string.

methods.name: createApacheLicenceComment
methods.description: Creates a Comment node containing the Apache License header.
